title: Personality Shapes Gender Bias in Persona-Conditioned LLM Narratives Across English and Hindi: An Empirical Investigation

bias_targets.methodology: A sentence-level centroid-based metric that calculates the difference in cosine similarity between the embeddings of generated narrative sentences and predefined male- and female-stereotypical reference centroids (created from curated word lists in English and Hindi), supplemented by human annotation via forced pairwise comparisons.
